svg.title: Normal distribution with sigma areas and process capability Cp Cpk
svg.text: Normal distribution – areas inside ±1σ, ±2σ, ±3σ, and process capability Cp / Cpk
φ(z) = exp(−z²/2)/√(2π), z = (x − μ)/σ. Areas computed with the error function (Python math.erf).
B – process with tolerance: Cp = 1.33, Cpk = 1.00
tolerance T = USL − LSL = 8σ; mean shifted +1σ toward USL
Cpk = min(USL − μ, μ − LSL) / (3·σ) – real capability (spread + centring)
Example B: Cp = 8σ/6σ = 1.33; Cpk = min(3σ, 5σ)/3σ = 1.00 → centre the process: Cpk rises to 1.33
Pp, Ppk: same formulas with the long-term (overall) standard deviation s instead of the short-term σ = R̄/d2
Out of tolerance (one side): p = 1 − Φ(3·Cpk); Φ = normal distribution function (table §24.1)
Rule: Cpk from ≥ 50 – 125 values of a stable process (control chart first). With n = 50 a measured Cpk 1.33 only proves ≈ 1.10 (95 % lower bound, §24.4).
